summary: Preinstall script downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (setup.mjs) that fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and then uses it to execute a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` blob with a large numeric constant table and a string-array rotator decoder (obfuscator.io shape), not declared in `package.json`'s `files`, with no relation to the package's advertised purpose (a React Native UI component kit). Both the loader (`setup.mjs`) and the payload use obfuscated `_0xXXXX` identifiers. The alternate-runtime is fetched specifically to run a script that Node-based scanners would not inspect, and installing the package causes arbitrary attacker-controlled code to execute on the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
